Maya Patel: Heads-up — noticing prefix hit rate drop for /embeddings-proxy around 03:10-04:20 UTC. Grafana shows panel 'prefix_hitrate_v2' down to ~42%. Anyone touching cache config last night?

Maya Patel: This one -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/prefix-cache/prefix-cache-overview?view=panel&panelId=7

Maya Patel: Query I'm eyeballing:
```
sum(rate(prefix_cache_hits_total{route="/embeddings-proxy"}[5m])) /
sum(rate(prefix_cache_requests_total{route="/embeddings-proxy"}[5m]))
```

A.J.: Thx. @Sam can you check if rollout 2026-03-16-emb-route happened in us-west?

Sam K: @Maya I did a small rollout, but only user-model routing, shouldn't affect prefix keys. I'll double-check kernels and prefetch config.

infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-16-emb-route succeeded on 3 hosts (i-0abc, i-0def, i-0ghi)

Eli: Could be eviction. Check eviction rate panel and kv_evictions_total. Also check memory pressure on hosts.

Maya Patel: Where is eviction panel? I only see hit/req panels.

Eli: /d/kv-ops/kv-evictions — https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv-ops/kv-evictions?panelId=2

Maya Patel: Logged an alert suggestion: lowering hitrate alert from 60% -> 50% for embeddings route; current noisy flapping during ramp. Who owns alert tuning?

A.J.: assign to eng-platform. @Sam can you take alert PR? Should include runbook note and example query to ignore short transient drops (<30m).

Sam K: I can. Will open PR to /infra/alerts with threshold change + annotation. ETA 2 hours :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: Thanks — tagging ops-oncall FYI @ops-oncall :eyes:

ops-oncall: I see spike in evictions at 03:12, will monitor and follow up if it repeats.

Maya Patel: Ok closing loop for now. If anyone sees sustained drop >45% for 45m please page.
